posts.excerptEnglish: Formal Statement We are collaborating with Xuezhongfei @Xuezhongfei (hereinafter referred to as the "Brand") for the artist's in-person event on November 21, 2026. The contract explicitly prohibits the Brand from distributing event admission tickets in any form for a fee. Recently, we discovered that the Brand publicly sold seats for this in-person event without obtaining our prior consent. We were completely unaware of this action beforehand, and it has misled the public and harmed the interests of fans. We strongly condemn this behavior. We hereby formally notify the Brand to immediately cease all ticket and seat sales, remove all related promotional materials, issue refunds to all ticket purchasers, and submit a written explanation and remedial plan to us. If the Brand refuses to rectify the situation, we will use all legal means to protect our lawful rights and interests. At the same time, we would like to remind all fans to protect their personal property and be wary of scams. Hou Minghao Studio November 15, 2026
